beats.note: Many real systems use both types together.
For example, when visiting a secure website, public key encryption helps your device and the website agree on a secret key.
Then, fast symmetric encryption protects the rest of the conversation.
Encryption is used in many parts of daily life.
When you see a padlock symbol in your web browser, HTTPS is helping encrypt the connection between your device and the website.
This helps protect passwords, shopping information, and other personal details.
